pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī bahussutā hoti bhāṇikā visāradā paṭṭhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.4: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā pariveṇaṃ udrīyati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.8: athakho te manussā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā pariveṇatthāya chandakaṃ saṅgharitvā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā parikkhāraṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.9: thullanandā bhikkhunī tena ca parikkhārena sayaṃpi yācitvā bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñji.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.15: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.18.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.8: ekabhikkhuniyā atthāya na saṅghassa na gaṇassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.12: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.14: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.17: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.21.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.22: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.23: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
